# Trendra

> Trendra (https://trendra.store) is an Indian online store for fashion, custom print T-shirts, footwear, beauty and home essentials, with low prices, Cash on Delivery on many items and shipping across India.

Trendra is a multi-vendor e-commerce store. Shoppers can browse products without an account; an account is needed to order. Some T-shirts can be customised with the shopper's own logo or design (prepaid only).

## Pages

- [Home](https://trendra.store/): Featured deals and categories.
- [All Products](https://trendra.store/products): Full catalog with category and price filters.
- [About](https://trendra.store/about): About Trendra.
- [Help Center](https://trendra.store/help): FAQs on orders, shipping, returns and payments.
- [Privacy Policy](https://trendra.store/privacy-policy)
- [Refund Policy](https://trendra.store/refund-policy)
- [Shipping Policy](https://trendra.store/shipping-policy)
